continuity_contract.current_milestone: Clear the fixed ContextBench contract through frozen evidence-led rounds while keeping ContextBench diagnostics distinct from semantic retention and repair correctness.
continuity_contract.enduring_objective: Improve reusable ARE reasoning, useful continuity, recovery, correctness and completed outcomes within cumulative model input plus output tokens.
continuity_contract.initial_objective: Finish GLM-5.3-flash qualification, beginning with small context windows and useful reasoning-state recovery under pressure.
continuity_contract.research_method: objective → gap → question → competing hypotheses → selection → experiment/tasks/criteria → results → observations → reviewed decision → successor

experiment_template.research_question: A generic policy preserves the scope of applicable preferences already retained and improves recommendation correctness.
stop_conditions: Disk and provider capacity gates before dispatch
Every actual request must be tokenized and admitted within 8000
No automatic retry, replacement or dropped outcome
No provider generation until exact immutable manifest and review gate pass
Unknown usage holds reservation and forbids success

success_criteria.limits_notice: Full trajectory cohort/call/cost freeze and independent review remain required. Policy-only or terminal-only diagnostics cannot pass campaign efficiency.
success_criteria.mechanism: every assigned answer completed and native-judge correct

records.falsifier: No replicated improvement, incomplete or invalid output, quality loss, or uncontrolled costs.
records.mechanism: Change only the common answer policy, keeping exact evidence projection, question, model, output cap and context admission unchanged.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash8K (8000 exact) development study; preserve ContextBench acceptance and original small-window objective. Diagnostic findings do not prove full-benchmark perfection.
records.statement: A generic policy preserves the scope of applicable preferences already retained and improves recommendation correctness.
